dedupe_keys.name: installations de valorisation du biogaz en pays de la loire

description: Installations de valorisation du biogaz en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.sigloire.fr. List of biogas recovery plants in the region, whether in operation, planned or shut down. This list comes from a cross between several sources operated by DREAL (S3IC, Sinoe, Wing, Ademe financing). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Biogas recovery facilities in Pays de la Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2016-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
